 Pistons vs. Sixers Discussion: Game Time, TV, Odds, and More
 Jalen Duren and Ausar Thompson both out tonight against the Sixers
 by Sean Corp Oct 25, 2026, 11:35 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Jalen Duren and Ausar Thompson are both out for the Detroit Pistons tonight as they visit the undefeated Philadelphia 76ers. Joel Embiid will be resting for the Sixers, but this will be a big matchup for the short-handed Pistons. Paul Reed will get the start for Duren, and here is hoping the former Sixer has some BBall Paul magic ready for his former team. It will also be a chance to see how much appetite JB Bickerstaff has for a Reed backup — is he going to go with the 3-point shooting of the undersized John Collins or is he going to go with the beefy, more limited Tolu Smith?
 Game Vitals
 When: 7:30 p.m. ET
 Where: Xfinity Mobile Arena, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
 Watch: TV: TV20 Detroit | Streaming: DAZN-Detroit
 Odds: Pistons +1.5
 Projected Lineups
 Detroit Pistons (2-0)
 Cade Cunningham, Duncan Robinson, Isaiah Joe, John Collins, Paul Reed
 Philadelphia 76ers (3-0)
 Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Adem Bona
